reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is improving in-app navigation by replacing the default DSH top-bar session title with a workspace/session breadcrumb and adding direct dropdown controls in the top bar for switching workspaces and sessions, as documented in the README and repository description.

summaries.zh: 该插件将 DSH 会话顶部标题改为“工作区 / 会话”面包屑，并提供顶栏内的工作区与会话下拉切换入口。
summaries.en: This plugin replaces the DSH session top bar title with a Workspace/Session breadcrumb and adds top-bar dropdown controls to switch workspaces and sessions.

capabilities: Replaces the DSH session top bar title with a workspace/session breadcrumb
Provides top-bar dropdowns for workspace and session switching
Offers inline workspace/session actions such as rename, add workspace, branch session, and archive session
Supports bilingual zh/en labels that follow DSH language switching

reasons.code: The README states the plugin is a UI enhancement for DSH that replaces the native top-bar session title with a two-level workspace/session breadcrumb.
